articles.title: A sharp limit on what reflection can change
articles.description: Adding and subtracting the same points can produce different answers. A proof pins down the largest reflected ratio on four sites: seven quarters.
articles.claimScope: A proved four-site optimum, a sharper bound for one prescribed five-site input profile, and an upper bound below two with a proof-condition exclusion for specified inputs with coordinate decay. The general five-site constant, unrestricted fourfold problem and historical priority remain unresolved.

citations.title: A bound for geometric weights on downward-closed sets
citations.authors: Algal Lab, with AI research agents
citations.detail: Boundary counting and coordinate projection bound both the reflected total and the intermediate proof estimate by 27936/13981 times the original total. Nested geometric layers extend the bound to nonzero finite inputs on the nonnegative coordinate grid whose heights shrink by a factor at most 5/9 at each positive coordinate step. The note specifies the fixed five-site profile and injective integer encodings. These inputs cannot enter the stated unresolved proof condition. This separate note is not part of the Version 11 PDF. Codex agents independently checked the mathematics by hand; no human peer review or historical-priority claim is made.
